entities.name: NAD(P)H-hydrate Nnr-like
observations: 480-aa sequence has 34–38% identity and about 96% coverage to reviewed Nnr homologs; sequence-based assignment is limited homology support.
Nnr homologs are annotated with NAD(P)HX epimerase and ADP-dependent (S)-NAD(P)HX dehydratase activities (EC 5.1.99.6 and EC 4.2.1.136).
Pfam hits: YjeF_N (PF03853) at residues 26–177 and Carb_kinase (PF01256) at residues 234–449.

entities.name: (6S)-NADHX repair
observations: Homolog reaction: (6S)-NADHX + ADP = AMP + phosphate + NADH + H+; Rhea RHEA:32223. Reaction is inferred for query from Nnr homology.

entities.name: NADHX epimerization
observations: Homolog reaction: (6R)-NADHX = (6S)-NADHX; Rhea RHEA:32215. Reaction is inferred for query from Nnr homology.

entities.name: NADPHX repair
observations: Homolog annotations include (6S)-NADPHX + ADP = AMP + phosphate + NADPH + H+ (Rhea RHEA:32235) and (6R)-NADPHX = (6S)-NADPHX (Rhea RHEA:32227); inferred for query from Nnr homology.
